services.name: Rankin Tuna Charters
services.desc: MacDougall Bluefin Tuna Charters gives you a one of a kind fishing experience. Captain Dan has been catching Giant Bluefin Tuna for 35 years. The knowledge and expertise of Dan and his crew, along with their east coast charm, are sure to impress. The Jan&Grace is a 45’ Hustler powered by a 625 HP Volvo-Penta engine complete with dual steering stations. It is fully equipped with a full array of modern electronics and safety equipment all Transport Canada approved. Dan takes pride in his new custom built 180 class rods, Penn 130 reels, as well as his custom built kite rod they love to use for that beautiful kite bite! The Father/Daughter dynamic on the Jan&Grace is what sets this crew aside

variants.label: Bluefin tuna fishing adventure in the Northumberland Strait and Southern Gulf of St Lawrence

blurb: Guests fish for large Bluefin tuna using techniques such as chumming, trolling, and kite fishing. The boat is fully equipped with commercial tuna rods, fighting chairs, and live-well tanks for live bait. The captain has lifelong experience and a captain's license, offering a prestigious fishing experience.
